summary: The warning for a schedule tick held by replication for 15 minutes now names the admission inputs that can hold it: whether replication admission is healthy, whether the schedule requires complete history, and for each peer whether its bounded-progress fallback counts as progressing, its healthy-exchange streak, and whether its measured member and inventory basis still match

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only the free-text reason of the existing operational.failure warning gains fields; admission and catch-up decisions are unchanged.
